Hi David —

Great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Recap / success criteria (what Clearwater will evaluate during the POC):
- Response latency for common workflows (avg < 250ms for 95th perc on sample prompts)
- End-to-end inference cost within target ($0.002/token avg)
- Integration ease: simple API + SDK integration into your routing layer
- Security: audit logs and KMS support validated by your InfoSec team
- Quality: model meets our agreed prompt set pass-rate >= 85% on your NLU tests

Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): share POC MA and the POC template (attached) — sign and return
- Week 1: sandbox setup + live inference on 1000 daily test prompts; Redwood provides SE support
- Week 2: run evaluation harness (latency/cost/quality) and collect results; joint review at end of week 2

Ownership / RACI (initial proposal):
- Redwood SE (Rishi Malhotra) — Responsible for infra integration and test harness setup
- Redwood CS (Lauren Bishop) — Account success owner; run onboarding and trial ops
- Redwood AE (me) — Account lead, commercial coordination and timeline
- Redwood Security (Neha Kapoor) — Support InfoSec calls and evidence requests
- Clearwater Infra (David / Mike Alvarez) — Responsible for firewall/VPC peering and any on-prem infra
- Clearwater Procurement (Jennifer Park) — Procurement/contract sign-off

Open items / asks for Clearwater:
- Please confirm the internal owners for infra, app, security, and procurement (name + email).
- Any constraints on network connectivity (VPC peering allowed? dedicated proxy?)
- Confirm target date for trial start (proposed Monday 2026-07-20)

Attachments: Redwood_POC_Template.xlsx (POC tasks & timeline), Clearwater_POC_MA.pdf (master agreement draft)

I’ll follow up with a RACI table and calendar invites once you confirm the owners.

Thanks,
